name: showreel-50-popover
style: Black look, KM.split pair (BEFORE / AFTER side by side, in step): one Share menu clipped by its card (2 of 4 items) vs the same menu as a popover (all 4); OPENS / CUT OFF meter; mint accent, coral for the cut; no phone, one slow push on the bug

voice.text: Why is your menu cut off? The card says overflow hidden, so it slices the menu in half. The fix: make the menu a popover. It jumps to the top layer, so no card can clip it. Now every item shows.

caption:
Why is your dropdown menu cut off? 👆 The menu sits inside a card with overflow: hidden, and that card slices anything that sticks out past its edge. Half the items are gone, and no z-index can bring them back. The fix: make the menu a popover. Put the popover attribute on the menu and a popovertarget on the button that opens it:
…
A popover opens in the top layer, above everything on the page, so no parent's overflow can clip it. Chrome 114, Firefox 125, Safari 17. 💾 Save this for your next dropdown, and send it to the friend who is still fighting z-index.

sources.note: MDN popover (page source mdn/content, read 28 Nov 2026): open popovers appear above all other elements in the top layer and won't be influenced by parent elements' position or overflow styling; a button with popovertarget opens it
MDN BCD api.HTMLElement.popover (read 28 Nov 2026): Chrome 114, Firefox 125, Safari 17
MDN overflow (read 28 Nov 2026): overflow: hidden clips content that overflows the element's box; no scrollbars
